immutable_fields: All original fields except target and quality_review checked identical in order; terminal targets equal raw.
context_checks: Read all current and previous context text; checked target against current raw for imported names, numbers, pronoun expansions, and unsupported facts. 64 context rows use exact supplied previous-piece suffix. No approved target relies on prior-piece content.
regional_cues: Cues checked for presence in raw; presence alone is not native-speaker certification. Regional appropriateness remains uncertain for synthetic examples.
coverage_limits: 35 scenario groups, not 160 independent scenarios. Text-only synthetic review, not audio or native-speaker certification.
method: Independent full pair review by Terra in pages of 16, respecting stock mode instructions and vocabulary decoys; ambiguous cases rejected and unambiguous targets corrected.
